notes: «رجل، من همدان يقال له أفلح» is named by the text itself, so the link is أفلح, not unnamed (rule 8)
«أنه سمع عليا، يقول» makes Ali the last link: his words relay the Prophet's saying
The compiler's remark «حديث ابن المبارك أولى ... فإن أبا أفلح أشبه» names another version's transmitter (Abu Aflah): a variant group, never a route of this saying (rule 4)
